The transparent material used to make windows is glass.

Antioxidants are molecules that help protect cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals. Free radicals can build up in the body and cause oxidative stress, which is linked to various health issues including heart disease, cancer, and aging. By neutralizing free radicals, antioxidants offer several benefits for health and wellness, such as reducing inflammation, supporting the immune system, and potentially lowering the risk of chronic diseases.
